messages.message: Current state of the Batch Decay tool.
The time to decay to. Units of s, m, h, d, y, or half-lives (e.g. "2 HL") are accepted.
Number of time points to evaluate, from time zero to the decay time. A value of 1 evaluates only at the decay time.

Sum all input nuclides into a single mixture and co-decay them (implies showing progeny). This lets the decay progeny of different ultimate parents mix together and be reported as a single line per nuclide. If not selected, each input is decayed on its own, so a progeny reached from more than one input is reported separately for each parent.
Also output the activity of every decay-progeny nuclide.
